# Hard Decks

> > Professional deck building, repair, and restoration services in Belvidere, IL and Northern Illinois, specializing in composite decking from Trex and TimberTech.

Hard Decks serves homeowners in Belvidere, Roscoe, Poplar Grove, and surrounding Boone and Winnebago County areas with expert deck construction, repair, and restoration services. The company focuses on both traditional pressure-treated wood and modern composite decking materials, providing comprehensive guides and local expertise for outdoor living projects.
